The curves flow straight into one another.
A big elevation change: 5,074 to 7,138 ft, with 2,178 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
10 parks, trailheads and other stops along it, so it's likely busier than most, especially on weekends.
July highs average 84°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 15 mph limit its curves ask for about 0.18 g.

roads.name: Little Cottonwood Road
words: Properly twisty: 30 curves in 5.7 miles, about 5 a mile.
A big elevation change: 5,618 to 8,022 ft, with 2,394 ft of up and down along the way.
Wooded nearly the whole way.
July highs average 82°F.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 40 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.39 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
